script.description: Normalize dot_number into the canonical unpadded string carriers uses, so boc3-agents-enrichment-policy can join. Same defect and same remedy as auth-history-pipeline: FMCSA zero-pads dot_number to eight characters here and not in carriers.csv, an enrich index compares the value as a keyword, and '00023680' never matches '23680'. Measured when the loader stopped discarding the padding: carriers' boc3_agents enrichment fell from 565,299 documents to zero. The BOC-3 shared-agent signal depends on this join, so a silent zero here removes evidence the matcher is built to use rather than merely losing a field. Note that '0' is a real value in this column and not a missing one -- 159,140 of 1,860,604 rows carry it -- so it must survive normalization as '0' rather than being dropped.
script.source: if (ctx.dot_number == null) { return; } String raw = String.valueOf(ctx.dot_number); int dot = raw.indexOf('.'); if (dot >= 0) { raw = raw.substring(0, dot); } if (raw.isEmpty()) { return; } ctx.dot_number = String.valueOf(Long.parseLong(raw));
